info.text:
Private college tuition runs $33,050 more a year on paper. After grants? Less than half that.

2025-26 average tuition and fees: $11,950 in-state public vs $45,000 private nonprofit (College Board).
Implied average grants per first-time full-time student (sticker minus net): $9,650 public vs $28,090 private.
Average net tuition and fees: about $2,300 public vs $16,910 private, a $14,610 yearly gap.
NACUBO estimates a 57.1% average freshman discount at private nonprofits in 2025-26; about 90% got school aid.

Sources: College Board, Trends in College Pricing and Student Aid 2025; NACUBO 2025 Tuition Discounting Study.
News and education, not financial advice.
